source.sqlReaderQuery: select MAX(LastModifytime) as NewWatermarkvalue from data_source_table

sqlReaderQuery.value:
select *
from data_source_table
where LastModifytime > CAST('@{activity('LookupOldWaterMarkActivity').output.firstRow.WatermarkValue}' AS DATETIME)
  and LastModifytime <= CAST('@{activity('LookupNewWaterMarkActivity').output.firstRow.NewWatermarkvalue}' AS DATETIME)
